text:
maria (PM): Heads-up: proposing a small experiment — "hot-swap" routing for tenant-priority rollouts. Idea is we can swap routing tables per-tenant without a full flag push so sales-critical customers can be bumped/downgraded instantly. Thinking: feature flag + per-tenant routing table + canary window. 

sam (eng): Sounds neat. Do you mean swapping a routing policy blob in the control plane and letting smart-routing pick it up? Or change per-request policy at the edge?

maria (PM): Control plane swap. Edge reads routing version. If control-plane swap fails, edge falls back to last-known good version. Goal: minimize blast radius and remove need for infra deploys for tenant moves.

jordan (sre): Important: we need an explicit circuit-breaker and kill-switch. If latency rises or error-rate for the new routing > SLO thresholds, automatic rollback to previous routing. Also add quick metrics: 95th latency, 5xx rate, queue depth.

eva (data): We'll need to tag telemetry by routing-version and tenant. Canary needs a small cohort with synthetic traffic and real user sampling. I can set up a quick dashboard and alerts.

alex (platform): From infra side, control-plane feature flags are fine. Two quick asks: 1) define the canary cohort selection (pct or tenant list), 2) define rollback thresholds.

maria (PM): Proposed config sketch: 
```
feature_flag: tenant_hot_swap
buckets:
  - name: sales-p0
    type: tenant_list
    tenants: [acct-9101, acct-402]
    pct: 5
  - name: general-p1
    type: pct
    pct: 10
kill_switch_url: /api/v1/flags/tenant_hot_swap/disable
metrics: [p95_latency_ms, error_rate_5xx, model_timeouts]
rollback_policy:
  - if error_rate_5xx > 1% for 2m => rollback
  - if p95_latency increases by 40% vs baseline => degrade to fallback model
```

sam (eng): Implementation note: routing blob should reference model_variant and model_pool. Edge caches routing for 30s, so swap propagation < 30s but we must flush KV cache for immediate effect if needed.

jordan (sre): Recommend also a staggered propagation: 1) control-plane updated, 2) warm nodes only, 3) full. Add a short hold (5m) after warm nodes for manual check.

eva (data): For canary signals: sample both real traffic and a synthetic probe hitting the same prompt set. We'll provide a baseline dataset for regressions.

alex (platform): I'll add a light-weight API to force immediate edge cache invalidation for emergency manual cutover. Needs RBAC and audit.

maria (PM): Launch criteria (minimum): 1) canary run for 48h with <0.5% 5xx and p95 within 20% of baseline; 2) dashboard and PagerDuty alerts configured; 3) manual kill-switch validated by SRE.

sam (eng): Who owns rollout orchestration? I can build the control-plane endpoints if Alex owns the cache invalidation and Jordan owns the SRE playbook.

jordan (sre): I'll write the runbook and add a short postmortem checklist — include how to escalate to hot failover and how to verify rollback succeeded.

eva (data): Deliverables from data: dashboard panels, automated canary eval script, and a weekly comparison job to catch slow regressions.

maria (PM): Ok owners: Sam -> control-plane implementation + routing blob schema, Alex -> cache invalidation + RBAC, Jordan -> SRE runbook + PDB thresholds, Eva -> telemetry and canary eval. I'll own rollout decisions and customer communication.

deploy-bot: Canary job queued: tenant_hot_swap.canary.2024-09-15T15:04Z

sam (eng): Quick question: do we allow multi-variant for same tenant (e.g., fallback model + experimental model simultaneously)? That affects routing blob shape.

maria (PM): Yes but only as explicit pairing in blob: primary + fallback. No automatic split across variants for same request in v1.

jordan (sre): One more: ensure audit logs for every routing swap (who, when, diff). If someone hot-swaps via UI, create an approval step for production.

alex (platform): Noted. I'll add an approval gate flag for prod-only swaps.

maria (PM): Next steps: Sam to post PR for schema by EOD Tue, Alex to prototype cache flush endpoint, Eva to seed canary dataset, Jordan to draft runbook. We'll reconvene Fri 10am to signoff. :thumbsup:

sam (eng): On it.

eva (data): I'll upload the sample prompts to the shared drive and link in the PR.

jordan (sre): Adding PD escalation policy now.

amaria (PM): Thanks all — this should give sales a fast path for tenant moves without infra deploys and keep safety tight.
